title: CLIC: Closed-Loop Intent Consistency for Securing LLM-Driven Control in Open RAN
abstract: arXiv:2610.40744v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the progressive capabilities of large language models (LLMs), researchers are finding ways to integrate them into the control loops of Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) to enable slicing and resource management through user intents. However, integration of LLMs in the O-RAN control loop via the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) makes the system vulnerable to \textit{runtime prompt injection threats}, which manipulate control decisions without violating interface authentication, and \textit{residual virtual prompt injection (VPI)} attacks that plant trigger mechanisms to silently steer the behaviour during fine-tuning. Existing studies address only the runtime threat and do not enforce consistency across the full control path, i.e. from the certified A1 intent, through the multi-step LLM trajectory, to the final E2 action. translated_title: CLIC：面向开放无线接入网中LLM驱动控制安全的闭环意图一致性
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能力的不断增强，研究人员正探索将其集成到开放无线接入网（O-RAN）控制环路中的方法，以通过用户意图实现网络切片与资源管理。然而，通过RAN智能控制器（RIC）将LLM集成到O-RAN控制环路中，会使系统面临两类威胁：一是运行时提示注入威胁，它能在不违反接口认证的情况下操纵控制决策；二是残余虚拟提示注入（VPI）攻击，它会在微调阶段植入触发机制，从而悄然引导系统行为。现有研究仅应对运行时威胁，且未在整个控制路径上强制保持一致性，即从经过认证的A1意图，经由多步LLM推理轨迹，直至最终的E2动作。我们提出了一种闭环意图一致性层（CLIC），能够联合缓解上述两类威胁。
tldr: 提出闭环意图一致性层CLIC，通过在从认证的A1意图、多步LLM推理到最终E2动作的完整控制路径上强制意图一致性，联合防御运行时提示注入和微调阶段的残余虚拟提示注入攻击，从而保障O-RAN中LLM驱动控制的安全。
en_tdlr: Proposes a closed-loop intent-consistency layer (CLIC) that enforces intent consistency across the full control path—from certified A1 intent through multi-step LLM trajectories to final E2 actions—to jointly mitigate both runtime prompt injection and residual virtual prompt injection attacks, securing LLM-driven control in O-RAN.
